verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents saving passkeys in its own vault and autofilling them through both its browser extension and its mobile apps, which supports passkeys that are not tied to a single platform vendor. The evidence never names specific operating systems, never states passkey support on the Windows or Linux desktop apps, and never describes cross-device passkey sync explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit per-platform passkey coverage (iOS, Android, Windows, Linux), desktop-app passkey support, explicit cross-device passkey sync documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor

citations.quote: Save passkeys in your Bitwarden vault and use the browser extension or mobile apps to autofill them across the apps and websites you use every day.
The most trusted open source password manager for passwords, passkeys, and secrets
